instruction.text: Select the sentence that is a command.

b: I was out shopping all day.
Belinda was shocked by the sight.
++Pass me that book.
He tried to argue with me.
She pushed him away.
He watched the clouds float by.
++Please don’t do that again.
Did you feed the chickens today?
Ryu washed up all the dishes today.
You’ve always been so kind.
++Zoe, tell the teacher I’m going home.
I really wanted to take a nap.
I forgot to pack my lunch for school.
Is this your brother?
++Tell me what happened yesterday.
She doesn’t eat tomatoes or onions.
I want to be friends with you forever.
He didn’t know what to say.
++Be honest with her about how you feel.
Imogen was so tired after her trip.
My dad always talks about football.
Our pet bird flew away.
++Open the window and let in some air.
I think I made a big mistake.
My mum won’t allow me to do that.
Leo is getting a kitten soon.
++Get some apples at the market for me.
You helped me so much last week.
Finn didn’t let me borrow his ruler.
They want to start a singing club.
++Help your sister with her homework, please.
Why would I tell Amanda your secret?
